scenario:
A software development company is implementing an enterprise-level Testing and Quality Assurance (QA) Management System to streamline the testing process of its software products. This platform will allow developers and QA engineers to define, manage, and execute test cases across different projects. Each test case will be executed multiple times to ensure the reliability and stability of the software.

The system must provide detailed reports on test executions, including the number of tests run, errors encountered, failures, and execution time. It should support categorization of tests into various groups and provide real-time analytics to assess the quality of the software. The platform should also manage information about projects, test suites, and individual test cases.

Users require the ability to analyze test results over time, identify trends, and pinpoint areas that need improvement. The system should offer role-based access to ensure only authorized personnel can modify test cases or view sensitive data. Moreover, integration with development tools and CI/CD pipelines is essential to automate testing workflows and improve efficiency.
